title: Preserve completed router turns when checkpoint events are ignored
description:
## Problem

The real Codex run for kbs-894b0c completed valid Python and Rust changes, but its router failed after the agent session while staging the checkpoint event. The exact error was: project/events is ignored and the checkpoint staging path did not force-add it. The branch and draft PR had to be preserved manually.

## Required behavior

Every router checkpoint and agent-turn event must be force-added through the same safe, scoped Git path used for shared router events. A completed or paused agent turn must publish its transcript metadata, checkpoint, branch, draft PR, summary/comment, and configured Review or Blocked state even when project/events is ignored. Nothing may be silently discarded.

## Acceptance criteria

- Python and Rust force-add only the configured event/checkpoint artifact, never unrelated ignored files.
- A completed agent result with an ignored project/events directory creates or updates its draft PR, adds the summary to the issue, and moves the issue to Review.
- A publication failure after a session exists produces a visible issue diagnostic and Review, preserving branch/session/log references.
- Tests exercise the ignored-event failure shape that occurred in kbs-894b0c.
- Git-only coordination remains sufficient; no MQTT, AWS, or automatic closure.
